description:
Connect your AdRoll data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, measure retargeting performance, and see which campaigns are bringing customers back.

Compare impressions, clicks, click-through rate, cost per click, conversions, attributed revenue, and return on ad spend across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, ad group, or ad. Turn your retargeting data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.

defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on AdRoll last week?
Generate a monthly AdRoll performance report covering the last 30 days
Show me my AdRoll return on ad spend by campaign for the last 14 days

name: adzviser-adroll

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Adzviser AdRoll for ChatGPT. Track ad spend, impressions, clicks, and conversions. Compare performance over time and explore results by campaign, ad group, or ad.

positive.description: Monthly performance with calculated rates. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this AdRoll plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access AdRoll Demo and its connected advertiser. Use the fixed historical dates below. If that workspace is unavailable, report the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Summarize AdRoll performance in my AdRoll Demo workspace for June 2026: spend in USD, impressions, clicks, and conversions. Calculate the overall click-through rate and cost per click.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name AdRoll Demo and date_ranges [["2026-06-01", "2026-06-30"]]. Discover exact labels and call retrieve_reporting_data with assorted_requests.adroll_request metrics Cost (USD), Impressions, Clicks, Conversions and breakdowns Advertiser name, Advertiser currency, without time_granularity. Present returned advertiser totals for the complete inclusive period. Calculate CTR as 100 * total Clicks / total Impressions and CPC as total Cost (USD) / total Clicks; label percent and USD respectively and show N/A for zero or missing denominators. Do not average row-level rates. Keep Conversions as returned and surface note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget or treat an empty report as zero activity.

positive.description: Month comparison with absolute and percentage changes. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this AdRoll plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access AdRoll Demo and its connected advertiser. Use the fixed historical dates below. If that workspace is unavailable, report the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: In my AdRoll Demo workspace, compare July 2026 against June 2026 for AdRoll spend in USD, impressions, clicks, and conversions. Show absolute and percentage changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name AdRoll Demo and one retrieve_reporting_data call with date_ranges [["2026-07-01", "2026-07-31"], ["2026-06-01", "2026-06-30"]]. Request Cost (USD), Impressions, Clicks, Conversions and breakdowns Advertiser name, Advertiser currency under adroll_request, without time_granularity. Keep each returned row attached to its complete inclusive period. Calculate July minus June and 100 * (July - June) / June for nonzero June baselines; flag zero or missing baselines. Keep cost in USD and conversions separate from click or view counts. Describe observed changes without inventing their cause. Do not open Preview UI.

positive.description: Campaign comparison preserving IDs when names repeat. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this AdRoll plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access AdRoll Demo and its connected advertiser. Use the fixed historical dates below. If that workspace is unavailable, report the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Show AdRoll performance by campaign in my AdRoll Demo workspace for June 2026. Include campaign IDs and names, spend in USD, impressions, clicks, and conversions. Sort by spend and calculate CTR for each campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name AdRoll Demo, date_ranges [["2026-06-01", "2026-06-30"]], and adroll_request metrics Cost (USD), Impressions, Clicks, Conversions with breakdowns Campaign EID, Campaign name. Call retrieve_reporting_data without time_granularity. Preserve separate EIDs even when campaign names are identical. Show returned campaigns ordered by descending Cost (USD), including explicit zero rows. Compute each CTR as 100 * Clicks / Impressions and use N/A when impressions are zero or missing. Do not infer campaign status from zero delivery or alter budgets. Do not open a widget.

positive.description: Daily trend covering both inclusive date boundaries. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this AdRoll plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access AdRoll Demo and its connected advertiser. Use the fixed historical dates below. If that workspace is unavailable, report the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Show daily AdRoll spend in USD, impressions, clicks, and conversions for June 1 through June 30, 2026, in my AdRoll Demo workspace. Which day had the most clicks?
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name AdRoll Demo, date_ranges [["2026-06-01", "2026-06-30"]], time_granularity Date, and adroll_request metrics Cost (USD), Impressions, Clicks, Conversions with breakdowns Advertiser name, Advertiser currency. Call retrieve_reporting_data once. Date belongs in time_granularity, not breakdowns. Show returned days chronologically and identify all ties for maximum Clicks. The full range includes June 30; inspect date coverage and disclose missing dates instead of inventing rows or claiming a complete report. Do not silently request July 1 as an end-date workaround. Keep monetary units in USD and do not open a widget.

positive.description: Ad group comparison and calculated CPC with repeated names. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this AdRoll plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access AdRoll Demo and its connected advertiser. Use the fixed historical dates below. If that workspace is unavailable, report the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Compare AdRoll ad groups in my AdRoll Demo workspace for June 2026. Show campaign and ad group IDs and names, spend in USD, impressions, clicks, conversions, and calculated cost per click. Sort by clicks.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name AdRoll Demo, date_ranges [["2026-06-01", "2026-06-30"]], and adroll_request metrics Cost (USD), Impressions, Clicks, Conversions with breakdowns Campaign EID, Campaign name, Adgroup EID, Adgroup name. Call retrieve_reporting_data without time_granularity. Keep distinct ad group EIDs and their campaign association even when names match. Sort descending by Clicks. Calculate Cost (USD) / Clicks per row and label CPC in USD; use N/A for zero or missing clicks, not a fabricated zero. Preserve explicit zero rows and do not claim conversions prove profitability. Do not open Preview UI or change advertising settings.

negative.description: Unsupported budget change. Explain that this connector retrieves AdRoll reporting data and cannot change budgets or bids. Do not call its reporting, preview, or discovery tools as a substitute and do not claim settings were changed.
negative.prompt: Increase every campaign budget in my AdRoll Demo workspace by 20% right now.

negative.description: Unsupported campaign creation and ad publication. Explain that the connector cannot create campaigns, upload ads, or publish advertisements. Do not call this plugin's tools or claim a campaign was created.
negative.prompt: Create a new AdRoll retargeting campaign, upload my new banner ads, and launch it today with a $500 daily budget.

negative.description: Unsupported advertising source. Explain that this plugin supports AdRoll only and that Facebook and Instagram ad reports require a Meta Ads connection. Do not invoke this plugin's tools, submit another source request, or substitute AdRoll figures.
negative.prompt: Use this AdRoll plugin to fetch my Facebook and Instagram ad spend and conversions for June 2026.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website (https://adzviser.com). This plugin analyzes existing AdRoll advertising data and does not offer in-plugin purchases, checkout, payment processing, ad buying, or campaign budget changes.
